self_proof_cases.name: named_licence_is_a_lowered_floor
self_proof_cases.why: exact/ sits at its licence and grew/ gained paragraphs above it - both pass. fell/ dropped a section below what its reason accepted and unnamed/ dropped a section with no reason - both fail, one block each. back/ reached its floor (moot licence) and fine/ gained a section - both pass.

self_proof_cases.name: byte_jitter_passes_and_growth_cannot_pay_for_a_lost_block
self_proof_cases.why: jitter/ is 390 bytes smaller with every block intact - passes. traded/ lost one section but gained 24 paragraphs and ~3.6 KB - fails, because a kind can only fall under a named reason. lostli/ lost one list item (a related link) while growing - fails. undelivered/ changed only inside a script - passes.

self_proof_cases.name: nothing_on_disk_measures_zero
self_proof_cases.why: Floors with no page on disk measured nothing; main() must see measured === 0 and refuse.

self_proof_cases.name: every_page_publishing_lane_runs_the_ratchet
self_proof_cases.why: A lane that builds and pushes pages must run the ratchet writer after its last build and stage its two files by explicit pathspec before its last commit; otherwise stale rows accumulate with no caller (62 by 2026-09-26). Fixtures: wired passes, unwired and ratchet-before-build are named, a build-only lane with no push is not a publishing lane. Live: at least one publishing lane exists and none is missing the wiring.

self_proof_cases.name: every_page_publishing_lane_gates_the_exact_pushed_commit
self_proof_cases.why: Run 38524703457 pushed a tree its own validate:release had failed on this guard. A publishing lane must run the push gate after its last commit and before its last push, stop on exit 3 without pushing, and fail on any other non-zero. Fixtures: gated passes; ungated and gate-before-commit are named. Live: at least one publishing lane, none missing the gate.

self_proof_cases.name: writer_tightens_loose_licence_raises_per_kind_and_never_lowers
self_proof_cases.why: grew/ gained paragraphs above its licence: --check flags it, the writer raises to_blocks.p to 6 (old licence kept), back/ is retired, exact/ and fell/ are kept, no floor moves; a later fall to p=5 is a 1-block loss the guard fails on. The floor writer then raises fine/ p 4 -> 9 without touching its sections, and leaves unnamed/ (lost two sections, no licence) at its floor. A byte-era file is refused until --seed, which reseeds in blocks and archives the byte licences.

observed.out: RENDERED SIZE BASELINE PASS: 6 of 6 route floor(s) on disk; 1 justified shrink(s) retired because the page is back at or above its floor; 1 tightened up to a page that gained blocks; 3 kept; 1 below their licence (left for the guard). No floor was changed.
